signal: pack.abstain_p of the routed lens (each lens's own evidence-coverage signal); logged per pack, never sent to Reactor
hint_text_if_enabled: If none of the passages states this about me, say that our conversations do not contain it.
enable_rule: Re-enable a soft hint (hint_text_if_enabled, never a forced abstention) for a route only when its abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on dev+dev200 pooled. Never on the temporal route (21 answerable packs at abstain_p >= 0.8).
reactor_evidence: Calibration E1 (12 dev questions): Reactor abstained correctly on 3/3 unanswerable questions without any hint, and wrongly abstained (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) on 1 multi-session question. The current failure mode is over-abstention on multi, not under-abstention, so an abstain hint would push the wrong way.
notes: Policy for v1: send passages only, no abstention hint; Reactor decides. AUC rose from 0.72 / 0.81 to 0.81 / 0.86 on dev / dev200 (role hand-off + ku b_r2 + temporal merged_r2), but no global threshold gets above about 0.3 precision (0.29 at 0.5 and at 0.8), so any hint would cost more false abstentions (each = wrong answer + CF1 0) than it saves. abstain_p is used only inside lenses (packing choices). Candidate for later: a counter-hint on the multi route when the pack holds >= 2 instance sentences ('the passages list items; count what they show'), only after a Reactor spot check, since one real multi question was over-abstained. Lens scales differ (temporal-A is discrete 0.05/0.25/0.6/0.75/0.8), so a per-route isotonic calibration on dev+dev200 pooled is the next step before any threshold.

previous_r1.signal: pack.abstain_p of the routed lens (each lens's own evidence-coverage signal)

previous_r1.notes: Do not tell Reactor to abstain from abstain_p yet. Over dev+dev200 (45 unanswerable vs 606 answerable) no threshold gets above about 0.25 precision: at 0.8 the final routed system has 13 true abstentions against 43 false ones. Lens scales also differ, so on test 6 of 45 ssu packs score 0.8 or more on questions that are probably answerable. One example is 'brand of the grill I last mentioned buying', where Big Green Egg is in the pack. Policy for now: send passages only and let Reactor decide from what they contain. abstain_p is used only for packing choices inside lenses. Re-enable a soft hint (hint_text_if_enabled, never a forced abstention) for a route once its own abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on dev+dev200 together. The candidates are evidence-based signals: missing event or phrase-bigram coverage for ku and temporal, and the missing-facet check for multi. Lens agents should calibrate abstain_p as a probability on dev+dev200 pooled, since each split alone has too few positives.
